Elaine (PM): Heads up — want to lock the Optimize toolkit rollout plan. Draft proposal: Wave 1 internal alpha (eng + 2 power users), Wave 2 customer pilots (3 customers), Wave 3 GA. Aim to minimize blast radius while getting measurable cost wins. Thoughts?
Matt (TPM): Sounds reasonable. How are we gating pilot -> GA? What are the must-have acceptance criteria?
Elaine (PM): Acceptance checklist I'm proposing: 1) p99 latency within target for typical chat workloads (<= 350ms on pilot provision), 2) per-request unit cost reduced >= 25% vs current hosted baseline for the covered flows, 3) <2% quality regressions on our eval suite (rolling), 4) eval-triggered alerts configured with clear owner and runbook, 5) runbook + rollback validated in staging.
Raj (Eng): A few notes on quantization: customers keep asking for int8 and int4. My recommendation: support int8 in pilot, make int4 opt-in later. We need a clear fallback path and perf profile for each quant level. Quantized models must pass eval gate with <1.5% delta on the primary QA metric.
Sasha (Eng-ML): Agree with Raj. Phased quant strategy: int8 for pilot, int4 as an opt-in beta. Also implement automatic fallback to fp16 if eval concordance drops beyond threshold. We should add a small snippet in the runbook: `eval_threshold = 0.02` (2% drop -> trigger).
Olivia (CS): From the customer side: pilots will demand per-tenant control and a clear opt-out for quantization. They also want eval-triggered alerts scoped per-deployment. We already have 3 interested pilots: Acme, Nimbly, HealthCo — all want visibility into how quality is measured.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: `optimize-toolkit/flags+telemetry` staging -> ready for manual promote :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Matt (TPM): Telemetry ask: dashboards for per-route token counts, batching hit-rate, cache hit-rate, quant fallback rate, and eval-alert counts. Ops needs SLO windows for rollouts plus visibility into traffic-shift steps during canaries.
Raj (Eng): Engineering asks: implement feature-flagging + runtime route policy for per-tenant overrides, and a staging infra that mirrors pilot traffic mix (prefix routing + synthetic load). Also need an API to query quant fallback stats per-tenant.
Elaine (PM): Proposed timeline (high level): week 0-2 implement flags + telemetry + eval-alert plumbing, week 3 run internal alpha (eng + 2 power users), week 4-6 run pilots with the 3 customers, week 7 soft GA (progressive rollout). Add a 2-week buffer for unexpected model quality fixes.
Sasha (Eng-ML): We should define eval-triggered alert semantics precisely: alert when eval suite concordance drops >2% over rolling 24h OR when a per-customer quality metric degrades >1% over rolling 6h. Action on alert = page oncall + begin traffic rollback procedures.
Raj (Eng): Auto-rollback details: fully automated rollback is risky. Propose two-step mitigation: first auto-deprioritize the quantized variant (shift 70% -> 30% reduction in quant traffic), then page if metrics do not recover in 15 minutes. This buys time for graceful failover.
Olivia (CS): Customer docs needed: reproducible eval sets, explainer on concordance metrics, and a checklist for pilot onboarding (including opt-out instructions). We'll prepare customer-facing materials and coordinate with the pilot CSMs.
Elaine (PM): Prioritization tradeoff: if we need to cut scope to hit date, drop int4 from initial pilot and ship int8 + caching + batching + eval-alerts. That captures most of the cost delta with reduced quality risk. Anyone opposed?
Matt (TPM): +1. Also add gating item: successful runbook drill (simulated rollback) and two simulated failovers in staging before pilot starts.
Sasha (Eng-ML): :thumbsup: One more: add a small acceptance metric for cache correctness — cache hit-rate should not introduce stale output beyond 0.1% of requests (measured via sampling).
Raj (Eng): Noted. I'll add per-route sampling hooks. Also we need a short RFC for the runtime-policy API so customers can opt-in per route.
Olivia (CS): I'll formalize the pilot list and send invites once staging is green. We should align on a clear feedback loop cadence (weekly sync + weekly eval digest).
Elaine (PM): Thanks all — next steps: Raj to schedule RFC + flag rollout plan by EOD Tue, Sasha to publish eval gating thresholds and runbook snippet, Olivia to draft pilot comms, Matt to own telemetry dashboard spec. We'll reconvene Fri for alpha readiness.
Matt (TPM): I'll put a quick deck together for the Fri sync with gating checklist and KPIs.
Elaine (PM): Perfect. If we have to trim, we cut int4 and keep everything else. Goal = measurable cost wins with safe, observable rollout.
Sasha (Eng-ML): Roger.
Olivia (CS): Roger.
Raj (Eng): Roger.
Elaine (PM): Closing thread — will follow up with action items as tasks. :white_check_mark:
